title: anisolobus pohlianus
intro: Anisolobus pohlianus, commonly known as the Australian plum, is a shrub or small tree native to Australia. The health benefits of Anisolobus pohlianus include its potential to support cardiovascular health and reduce inflammation due to its high antioxidant content. Its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its anthocyanins, which act as vasodilators and may help to lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Anisolobus pohlianus include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
